arguments.why: The fused arc-wall assumption broke: short and thick it needs ~202 N (user-reported G6 fact) against a 2-10 N hand budget, with 7.2%/6.1% strain against 1.38%/0.69% allowed, so the crank would stall or the wall would break. The long thin diagonal leaf bends in-plane with root fillet, and the harness measures 6.46 N and 0.74% on this version, inside the asked window. So the geometry is kept unchanged (leaf 1.26 mm); only the probe load box, which sits 1.25 mm north of any mesh surface, is moved onto the bump face so click_push can be compared with flex gear1/base, and the missing G7 close views are retaken on the final meshes.

result.chosen: diagonal in-plane leaf + finger + bump (kept, leaf 1.26 mm)
